hook_text: My phone is hibernating like a bear

song.title: Hibernate
song.style: English, cozy country waltz, acoustic guitar, pedal steel, gentle fiddle, warm friendly male lead vocal, slightly raspy, 3/4 time, 90 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Winter nights, the buzzing grew
Pinging all the whole night through
Saw a bear asleep for months
Thought my phone could try it once

[Chorus]
Hibernate, hibernate
Little brick, the pings can wait
Soup and snow and stories read
Wake me when the flowers bloom

shots.prompt: {moss} lies in bed at night wide awake with huge round eyes as a cold blue light flickers on the wall beside him. Static medium shot. Dark blue night light.
{moss} peeks out of a frosty window and sees a fuzzy brown bear yawning and curling up inside a snowy cave in the woods. Over the shoulder shot. Pale blue moonlight.
{moss} taps his chin, then his eyes light up with an idea and he grins under his mustache. Static close-up. Warm lamp light.

A hand slides a black smartphone face-first into a small rounded moss-green brick stuck to a white fridge door, the phone settling upright. The brick has a round pale yellow disc on its front. Warm kitchen light drifts across the fridge. Static close-up, the camera eases back slightly as the hand pulls away.
{moss} stirs a big pot of soup on a stove, steam curling up around his glasses, and sniffs happily. The camera pushes in gently. Warm kitchen glow, orange and cream.
{moss} ducks behind a snowman as a snowball flies past, then pops up laughing and throws one back. Static wide shot. Bright white snow, soft blue sky.
{moss} reads a thick book in an armchair by a crackling fire with a sleeping cat on his lap. The camera slowly drifts closer. Warm firelight.
{moss} wobbles across a frozen pond on ice skates, holding hands with a friend, both giggling. The camera circles slowly. Pale winter sun.
{moss} opens his front door to melting snow and a single green sprout poking up, and stretches his arms wide in the spring sunshine. Slow push in. Soft green and warm gold.

caption: Moss put his phone into hibernation in its Hibernator. Soup, snow, books. See you in spring, little guy.
